rca of the issue: Previously the CreditLimitsCard's useEffect had empty deps [] so its /api/credit-governance/caps request fired before AuthProvider's async token restore finished (401). Fix: depend on useAuth().token and return early when !token. Retest confirms exactly one request goes out post-restore and returns 200 (owner) / 403 (member), with the card rendering / hiding correctly in each case.
